name: claude-builder
description: The /builder:* build pipeline — a dependency-free, project-agnostic Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: builder
plugins.description: Sizes the work, specs it, audits it once, builds it one app per phase through its own subagent task loop, stops for a human walk, then verifies and ships. Reads every project fact from one host file, .claude/builder.md. No dependencies.
